name: Gamagōri (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Gamagōri city emblem in white: a disc crossed by a light blue horizontal bar.
history: Municipal flag of Gamagōri, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 8 April 1989; the emblem dates from 20 July 1955.

features.role: Gamagōri city emblem — a disc crossed by a light blue horizontal bar
